<title level="1" right="Cantrip 1" pfs="Standard">
[Eat Fire](/Spells.aspx?ID=1352)
<actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 119

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** You would take fire damage.

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until the end of your next turn
</row>

</column>

---

You consume and ingest fire, making it less harmful to you. You gain resistance 5 to fire damage until the end of the current turn. During the remaining duration of the spell, you can use the Belch Smoke action. The spell ends if you fall [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38), inhale, or exhale (this includes speaking).

 **Belch Smoke** <actions string="Single Action" /> You exhale what remains of the smoke, ending the spell and creating a smoke cloud in a 5-foot burst within 20 feet. All creatures within the smoke cloud are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4), and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

---
**Heightened (+3)** The resistance increases by 5.
